description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the DetectPedestrian operation for human body detection
description_zh: 本文介绍人体检测DetectPedestrian的语法及示例
name: DetectPedestrian

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an China (Shanghai) region Object Storage Service (OSS) URL. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:

Image format: JPEG, JPG, PNG, or BMP.
Image size: No larger than 4 MB.
Image resolution: Greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side must be less than 2000 pixels, and the face must occupy at least 64 × 64 pixels.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：

图像格式：JPEG、JPG、PNG、BMP。
图像大小：不超过4 MB。
图像分辨率：分辨率大于32×32， 分辨率小于2000×2000像素，最长边小于2000像素， 人脸占比不低于64×64像素。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.name: image_url

Elements.description_en: The collection of human body detection bounding boxes

items.description_en: The bounding box coordinates in the format `[left, top, right, bottom]`. `left` is the x-coordinate of the upper-left corner, `top` is the y-coordinate of the upper-left corner, `right` is the x-coordinate of the lower-right corner, and `bottom` is the y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the human body detection bounding box
items.description_zh: 检测框坐标，格式为`[left, top, right, bottom]`。其中`left`为人体检测框左上角横坐标，`top`为人体检测框左上角纵坐标，`right`为人体检测框右下角横坐标，`bottom`为人体检测框右下角纵坐标

Score.description_en: The confidence score of the bounding box. Valid values: 0 to 1. A score closer to 1 indicates a higher probability that the bounding box accurately contains a human body
Score.description_zh: 检测框的置信度，取值范围为0~1，得分越接近1表示人体框准确的概率越大

Type.description_en: The detection result type corresponding to the bounding box. Only the value `person` is returned
Type.description_zh: 检测框对应的检测结果类型。仅返回参数值`person`

Height.description_en: The height of the input image, in pixels
Height.description_zh: 输入图像的高度，单位像素

Width.description_en: The width of the input image, in pixels
Width.description_zh: 输入图像的宽度，单位像素
